title: Kenyan-Style Fluffy Ugali Porridge
description: A hearty and comforting Kenyan-inspired dish made with fluffy, kenyan, ugali, and porridge.
instructions: In a large pot, combine fluffy, kenyan, and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add porridge and stir to combine.
Add coconut oil, salt, and dried ginger. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the porridge has thickened.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with optional sugar to taste.
